member.name: T:SAAC.Groups.GroupInstant
member.summary:
What a group is doing at one instant: where each participant is and which way it faces, who is speaking, who is looking at whom or at what, which pairs stand in a formation, what each one holds, and what was detected in the last few seconds.
It is the counterpart of , which describes the last sliding window: here nothing is a mean or a count, everything is the state of the instant, for any number of participants. What is not known is left out: a group without eye tracking has no look, and says what the state was built from.

member.name: T:SAAC.Groups.SimplifiedFlockGroupsDetector
member.summary: Simplified model detection for detecting groups inspired by Flock agents (https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/1605401). Uses a variant of Reynolds rules: * Flock Centering: attempt to stay close to nearby flockmates (distance). * Collision Avoidance: avoid collisions with nearby flockmates (same direction in movement). * Velocity Matching: attempt to match velocity with nearby flockmates (velocity).
